name: Simulate Mono
description: Simulate mono room impulse responses with pyroomacoustics: the image source method (ISM), plus ray tracing (RT) by default. The reference of Simulate Binaural and Simulate Ambisonics. Writes the responses to the impulse response graph under 'mono' and 'data'.

inputParameters.name: ism_order
inputParameters.description: Highest image source (ISM) order. With ray tracing, the ray tracer takes over after it.

inputParameters.name: ray_tracing
inputParameters.description: Add ray tracing after the image sources (default True). Off: image sources only. Materials without scattering coefficients scatter 0.05.

inputParameters.name: n_rays
inputParameters.description: Number of rays per source. Ray tracing only.

inputParameters.name: absorb_air
inputParameters.description: Whether to consider air absorption (default True).

inputParameters.name: energy_thres
inputParameters.description: Energy at which a ray is stopped (pyroomacoustics' own default). Ray tracing only.

inputParameters.name: duration
inputParameters.description: Length of the responses in seconds (default: 1.5 times the longest Eyring reverberation time, 0.5 to 12 s). Ray tracing only.

inputParameters.name: seed
inputParameters.description: Random seed of the ray tracing. Empty (default): a new random seed each run, shown in the component's message. A number: the same scene gives the same responses, another number another draw. Ray tracing only.

inputParameters.name: normalize
inputParameters.description: Whether the impulse responses are peak-normalized (default True). The raw level is always kept and used for auralisation.

outputParameters.name: mono_ir_graph
outputParameters.description: IR graph of the mono responses (under 'mono'), for Deconstruct IR Graph or the reference of Simulate Binaural and Simulate Ambisonics.
